payout_quote: Douglas County GA: Manager $356 flat, Assistant Manager $338 flat, Poll Workers $270 flat — compensation includes paid training, precinct setup, and Election Day. Election Day: arrive 6:00 a.m., work until 7:00 p.m.
steps: Complete paid training and precinct setup
catches: Flat rate bundles training, setup, and a 13-hour Election Day — the hourly equivalent is modest.
Manager roles carry more responsibility for the higher flat rate.
biggest_catch: Flat $270–$356 bundles everything — about $20/hour for poll workers across training, setup, and Election Day.
eligibility: US citizens 18+ (registered voters preferred), Douglas County GA.
timing: Paid after the election per county payroll.
